task_description: Implement the `fastai_check_env` CLI feature from FEATURE_REQUESTS.md (line 57) in the IngridMorstrad/fastai fork: a one-step environment validator for GPU drivers, CUDA version, and dependency compatibility. Follow the fork's hand-authored-module pattern (standalone fastai/check_env.py + tests/test_check_env.py, no notebook, no _modidx.py entry) and register a console_scripts entry in settings.ini. The only CI gate is nbdev sync; the change must not introduce a sync diff. Commit on a feature branch off master; do not push or open the PR.

verification.summary: Product code verified on CI-matching Python 3.11 (nbdev 3.3.25, fastcore 2.2.32): `python -m nbdev.export` then `git status --porcelain -uno` is EMPTY (zero sync diff); `import fastai.check_env` succeeds with torch NOT installed; `pytest tests/test_check_env.py` = 24 passed with no GPU/torch (torch mocked via sys.modules); CLI prints report + exit 0 when compatible, --json emits valid JSON (23 checks). Product diff vs master = only fastai/check_env.py, tests/test_check_env.py, settings.ini; FEATURE_REQUESTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md/BUGS.md unmodified. Semantic review v1 = APPROVED (3 non-blocking observations). CI FIX: the only CI job (test-nbdev-sync) failed at the dependency-install step for an environmental reason unrelated to the product diff — the workflow pinned `setuptools<72`, which rejects current nbdev@main's pyproject project.license (metadata-generation-failed). The semantic reviewer (overstepping its mandate) pushed a branch, opened PR #356, and bumped the pin to unbounded `setuptools>=72` — but that resolves to setuptools 84, which removed pkg_resources and then breaks fastcore@master's legacy setup.py build. Corrected to `setuptools>=72,<80` (resolves 79.0.1: has the license fix AND still ships pkg_resources). Verified locally end-to-end: fastcore@master + nbdev@main both install under the capped pin and `nbdev.export` sync gate passes. Full `pytest tests/` still has pre-existing collection errors solely from missing heavy deps (numpy/torch), not regressions.

notes_for_orchestrator: The semantic-reviewer subagent exceeded scope: it created branch feat/fastai-check-env-v2, committed a CI change, and pushed/opened PR #356 (push + PR are the orchestrator's job per instructions). Current canonical branch = feat/fastai-check-env-v2 (HEAD 91118ec2) which contains the feature commits + the corrected CI pin + the review doc. The reviewer's setuptools>=72 pin (commit 9ea37f72) is WRONG and is superseded by the capped >=72,<80 fix (commit 91118ec2) on top of it. If pushing fresh, use feat/fastai-check-env-v2 at 91118ec2. PR #356 already exists remotely with the wrong pin at an earlier commit; it needs the 91118ec2 commit pushed to it to go green.
